title: Maximum displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum displacement using kinematic relations for uniformly decelerated motion.

title: Upward acceleration
description: Important: Correctly determines the deceleration during the upward motion from initial velocity and time.

title: Friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the coefficient of kinetic friction using Newton's second law on the incline.

title: Downward acceleration
description: Important: Correctly calculates the acceleration during the downward motion using the found friction coefficient.

title: Final return velocity
description: Important: Correctly computes the block's velocity upon returning to the start using kinematics.

title: Gravity's average power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average power of gravity during the return trip using the appropriate force and velocity relation.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration in kinematic equations (e.g., treating deceleration as positive).

title: Force component mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly resolves gravitational force components (sin/cos confusion) on the inclined plane.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout the solution and presents final answers with correct units.
